name: Pulse Turnkey- Formerly Texas Solar Solutions LLC
old_description: "I had an amazing experience from start to finish! The team walked me through every step with honesty and professionalism, making the entire process simple and stress-free. The quality of work speaks for itself. Highly recommend!
about:
Pulse Turnkey, based in Fort Worth, Texas, was founded in 2020 by James Lockhart. Lockhart, a former top-performing solar salesman, launched the company with three team members after earning national sales recognition four years running. The business remains privately held and has grown to over 60 employees.

The firm operates as a vertically integrated electrical contractor and EPC provider, delivering solar photovoltaic installations, battery backup systems, generator backup power, and roofing services across Texas, Oklahoma, Colorado, Utah, and Louisiana. With in-house crews and proprietary project-management software, Pulse Turnkey handles engineering, permitting, procurement, installation, and commissioning. The company reports more than 100 active projects and annual revenue exceeding $33 million.

Customers range from homeowners to commercial, industrial, and government clients, including schools and developers. The company's solar work spans residential rooftops to large-scale commercial arrays, while its roofing division installs asphalt shingles, metal, TPO, and flat-roof systems. Generator and battery solutions are tailored for critical-load backup and whole-facility resilience.

Lockhart has emphasized a debt-free balance sheet and a culture built on family and long-time associates. Pulse Turnkey was named a Top Solar Installer by Forbes, and its crews hold NABCEP certification. The company markets itself as a one-stop shop for multi-trade construction, differentiating through end-to-end control and transparent project tracking.
